_doc: Hand-authored unit → OSM footprint assignments for v0.3.16. scripts/bakeFootprints.py resolves each way via Overpass (nigian 127.0.0.1:12346 first, public mirror fallback) into local metres and writes src/data/footprints.json. basis: OSM-TAGGED = OSM tags name the role; SOURCE = a public document places the unit; ESTIMATE = real OSM outline, role inferred from process logic + ortho cross-check. Geometry is always the OSM outline unless a unit says synthetic (then the geometry itself is ESTIMATE).

primary.note: Four OSM water=wastewater circles (≈403 m² each, r≈11 m) beside the digesters; smallest circular tanks upstream of aeration, so taken as primaries.

aeration.note: Single L-shaped OSM wastewater polygon (≈5,200 m²); ortho shows anoxic cells (NW leg) and the aeration grid as one outline. 2023 tender confirms anoxic-zone mixers and a primary effluent channel feeding it.

secondary.note: Four OSM content=sewage circles (≈1,063 m², r≈18.4 m) downstream (east) of aeration.

headworks.note: ≈440 m² OSM building on the west side, upstream of the primaries; OSM does not name it.

solids.note: Largest OSM building (≈2,130 m²) between primaries/digesters and aeration — taken as the WAS thickening / centrifuge dewatering building. Could instead be the blower building (T2024-198).

disinfection.note: ≈640 m² OSM building directly downstream (SE) of the secondary clarifiers — taken as the UV building (2023 tender: UV system + UV bypass chamber).

primary.note: EA Fig. 2-1 (Site Plan, p.11) puts 'Preliminary and Primary Treatment' at this partitioned rectangle SW of Plant 2 (located by matching the figure to the ortho); T2021-134 confirms four rectangular primaries (3 Fujiwara mechanisms each). OSM maps the outer wall only — the 4 lanes are split evenly inside it (ESTIMATE).

aeration.note: Two OSM wastewater outlines with plug-flow lanes on the former biosolids-lagoon site — the Plant 3 aeration tanks per EA Contract 4 (lagoons decommissioned in Contract 1).

secondary.note: Ten OSM content=sewage circles on the lagoon site (6 × r≈19.3 m, 4 × r≈16.8 m); EA Contract 4 describes new final clarifiers in groups of four.

headworks.note: ≈1,060 m² OSM building immediately SE of the primaries; EA Fig. 2-1 co-locates preliminary + primary treatment and Contract 3A replaces the headworks.

disinfection.note: 1,355 m² OSM building on the river side near the old chlorination/dechlorination facility (Fig. 2-1); EA: new UV disinfection + effluent pumping station.

solids.note: 948 m² OSM building between the Plant 3 tanks — taken as the WAS thickening building (EA Contract 5 'new sludge thickening'). Dewatering is off-site at Manitou Dr.

notes.digesters: Digestion Complex at way/515109518 per EA Fig. 2-1 (SOURCE); tank circles fitted inside the OSM building outline (v0.3.13).

unmapped: Plant 1 aeration grid and 4 Plant 2 circular clarifiers are visible in the ortho (between the digestion complex and the primaries) but have no OSM polygon — not modelled (Plant 1 is slated for decommissioning in EA Phase 3).
Plant 2 aeration tanks: no OSM polygon.
conflicts: v0.3.13–0.3.15 placed 45×18 m synthetic primaries on open ground east of the clarifiers and used way/39457430 as aeration; EA Fig. 2-1 shows that rectangle is the primary facility (Code Critic P0).

primary.note: Three OSM wastewater circles (≈351 m², r≈10.6 m). Galt runs primaries and secondaries; OSM maps only these three, so they stand in for the primaries.

aeration.note: 1,260 m² OSM wastewater rectangle with lanes — Plant B aeration (T2020-123 adds anoxic zone + diffusers).

tertiary.note: Only OSM building inside the fence (302 m², building=service) — taken as the disc-filter building (T2020-123 replaces sand filters with disc filtration).

unmapped: Headworks, grit, UV and Plant A tanks have no OSM polygons; several buildings visible in the ortho are unmapped.
conflicts: Role of the three circles (primary vs secondary) is not confirmed by a public site plan.

aeration.note: Two largest OSM water=basin outlines (≈18,000 m² each) — North and expanded South Plant aeration (South expanded 22,000 → 41,100 m³, plug flow).

primary.note: Two ≈5,400 m² OSM basins north of aeration — taken as the primary (CEPT) tanks.

secondary.note: Eight ≈1,267 m² rectangular OSM basins. NACS: South Plant clarifiers expanded to six chain-and-flight units, 7,290 m² total (1,215 m² each) — matches tank size.

digesters.note: Two lobed OSM building outlines (3,953 m² each) shaped like paired round tanks — taken as the digester complex (City: three primary + one secondary digester).

tertiary.note: Largest OSM building on site (6,279 m², building=service) — taken as the Tertiary Treatment Facility (10 disk-filter trains, 63 MLD each).

excluded.reason: OSM water=reservoir inside the WWTP fence — not a process tank (v0.3.15 counted it as aeration, stretching the basin group to ~900 m).
OSM water=river (Red Hill Creek) crosses the WWTP outline — not a process tank.

unmapped: New chlorine contact tank (≈10,420 m³) and headworks have no OSM polygon.
conflicts: OSM shows 8 rectangular clarifier-sized basins; NACS describes 6 South Plant clarifiers — the other 2 may belong to the North Plant.

primary.note: Three identical CanVec-sourced wastewater outlines (2,734 m²) — v0.3.15 split them 2 primary / 1 aeration; now treated alike as primary tanks.

aeration.note: Two large CanVec wastewater outlines (≈37,000–39,000 m²) — the aeration/secondary complexes.

notes.digesters: OSM man_made=storage_tank rings (OSM-TAGGED role is generic storage tank; digester use per City facility page).

unmapped: Secondary clarifiers are not mapped separately in OSM.
conflicts: The geo bake picked a 1,910 m² water polygon at (−316, −241) as a primary; live OSM puts it outside the WWTP outline, so it is dropped.

primary.label: Oxidation Ditch
primary.note: Racetrack-shaped OSM water=wastewater outline (980 m²) — the oxidation ditch named in the Master Plan.

secondary.note: Secondary clarifiers are not mapped in OSM; two r=6.5 m tanks (sized for ~1.45 MLD at ~20 m³/m²·d) placed on open grass east of the ditch (ortho cross-check). Geometry and position are ESTIMATE.

headworks.note: 478 m² OSM building at the site entrance — taken as the headworks/control building.

tertiary.note: 558 m² OSM building — taken as the tertiary filter + UV building.

solids.note: 66 m² OSM building — aerated sludge holding blower/control kiosk.

unmapped: Aerated sludge holding tank and UV channel have no OSM polygon.
